name: Rougetsu Toshi
source:
Tokyo at the end of the century got completely blocked from the outside world due to transformation of Kanto plains and emergence of black fog that blocks radio waves. The raise of shady organizations and appearance of strange dreams make people uneasy. Hero acquires mysterious power to oppose those threats.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
世纪末的东京，由于关东平原的变化以及阻挡无线电波的黑雾的出现，与外界完全隔绝。黑幕组织的兴起，奇异梦境的出现，让人心神不安。英雄获得了对抗这些威胁的神秘力量。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
